complaints.title: Retention of Original 10th/12th Certificates & Delay in Fee Refund Post-Counseling Withdrawal
complaints.description: First-year engineering students who formally withdrew admissions before the CAP counseling cutoff report that the institution administration has withheld original academic certificates and demanded first-semester fees as penalty before releasing documents.
complaints.subcategory: Retention of Original Certificates / Fee Refund Delay

complaints.title: Original Transfer Certificates Retained for 12 Students Despite Regulatory Cutoff Compliance
complaints.description: Representation submitted on behalf of 12 admitted students reporting that original migration and transfer certificates are withheld by the college registrar despite formal resignation receipts issued within the counseling refund window.
complaints.subcategory: Retention of Original Certificates / Fee Refund Delay

complaints.title: Alleged Excess Admission of 42 Students Beyond Sanctioned EoA Intake in AI & Data Science
complaints.description: Scrutiny audit representation alleging that the institution enrolled 162 candidates against an approved EoA quota of 120 seats in B.Tech Artificial Intelligence & Data Science under unapproved management quota conversions.

complaints.title: Five-Month Arrears in Faculty Salary Disbursement & Non-Remittance of EPF Contributions
complaints.description: Faculty forum representation signed by 28 assistant and associate professors reporting non-disbursement of monthly salaries since May 2026 alongside failure to credit employee provident fund deductions.
complaints.subcategory: Non-Payment of Prescribed Scale / Faculty Shortage
complaints.resolutionSummary: Institution submitted bank RTGS/NEFT clearance proofs for 3 months arrears and furnished an irrevocable board undertaking for the remaining balance within 15 days.

complaints.title: Expired Fire Safety NOC and Inadequate Chemical Exhaust in Core Chemistry Laboratories
complaints.description: Safety audit notice indicating that the departmental chemical synthesis labs are operating with expired local municipal Fire Safety NOC certificates and defective fume filtration equipment.
complaints.subcategory: Expired Fire Safety NOC / Structural Hazard
complaints.institutionName: Jadavpur University - Faculty of Engineering & Technology

complaints.title: Delay in Biometric Verification Upload for AICTE Post Graduate Scholarship Cohort
complaints.description: Thirty-four GATE-qualified M.Tech scholars report institutional administrative delay in uploading monthly biometric attendance rosters to the National Scholarship Portal, impeding stipend disbursement.
complaints.subcategory: Scholarship Disbursement Delay / Unauthorized Fee Levy
complaints.resolutionSummary: Institution nodal officer uploaded biometric attendance rosters for all 34 scholars; verified by AICTE Finance Bureau and scholarship credits initiated.

complaints.title: Absence of Updated Mandatory Public Disclosure & Faculty Roster on Official Website
complaints.description: Regulatory scrutiny noting non-compliance with AICTE Mandatory Disclosure guidelines for Academic Year 2026-27, including missing audited financial accounts and approved faculty credentials on portal.
complaints.resolutionSummary: Institution published updated Mandatory Disclosure documentation, committee compositions, and faculty roster with verified AICTE URLs.

complaints.title: Levy of Mandatory Unapproved Campus Placement Fee on Final-Year Diploma Students
complaints.description: Final-year students submitted bank payment receipts indicating compulsory cash levies of Rs. 8,500 under "Corporate Placement Readiness" without statutory state fee committee approval.
complaints.subcategory: Collection of Unapproved Development or Capitation Charges

complaints.title: Inaccessible Academic Blocks & Lack of Wheelchair Ramps for Physically Challenged Students
complaints.description: Representation detailing absence of barrier-free elevators, tactile paving, and accessible restrooms in the architectural studios, violating Divyangjan guidelines of AICTE APH.
complaints.subcategory: Lack of Barrier-Free Access for Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan)

complaints.title: Withholding of Relieving Orders & Experience Certificates for Resigned Assistant Professors
complaints.description: Four faculty members who completed their contractual three-month notice period report refusal by the institute management to issue formal relieving letters and experience certificates.
complaints.subcategory: Withholding of Experience Certificate / Relieving Letter

complaints.title: Delayed Processing of Full Tuition Fee Refund Following National Counseling Seat Upgrade
complaints.description: Student secured seat upgrade in Round-3 state admissions counseling and submitted cancellation before October 15. Institution accounts desk has not refunded the initial deposit.
complaints.subcategory: Retention of Original Certificates / Fee Refund Delay

complaints.title: Non-Refund of Institutional Caution & Library Deposit for 2025 Graduating Batch
complaints.description: Graduated engineering batch alumni report institutional failure to return statutory library caution deposits of Rs. 10,000 per student despite full clearances obtained 8 months ago.
complaints.subcategory: Non-Refund of Caution Deposit / Library Deposit

complaints.title: Severe Deficiency in Cadre Ratio & Insufficient Regular Professors in Mechanical Engineering
complaints.description: Academic quality inspection reveals that against a statutory requirement of 4 Professors and 8 Associate Professors, the department is functioning entirely with temporary ad-hoc lecturers.
complaints.subcategory: Deficit in Cadre Ratio & PhD Faculty Norms

complaints.title: Non-Constitution of Statutory Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) on Campus
complaints.description: Grievance highlighting failure of the institute to notify a duly constituted SGRC headed by a retired District Judge or Senior Professor as mandated by AICTE 2019 Regulations.
complaints.subcategory: Non-Constitution of Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC)
complaints.resolutionSummary: Institution notified SGRC reconstitution circular, appointed independent Ombudsman, and published emergency contact protocols.

complaints.title: Inadequate Computing Workstations & Obsolete Software Versions in Computer Science Lab
complaints.description: Laboratory inspection reveals a student-to-computer ratio of 6:1 against the mandated 2:1 norm in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, hindering practical curriculum execution.
complaints.subcategory: Inadequate Core Laboratory Equipment / Defective Computers

complaints.title: Allegation of Anti-Ragging Guidelines Violation in University Boys Hostel Complex
complaints.description: Urgent complaint submitted to the National Anti-Ragging Helpline alleging late-night intimidation in the freshman hostel block and failure of hostel wardens to log incidents in the disciplinary register.
complaints.institutionName: Jadavpur University - Faculty of Engineering & Technology

comments.content: Cross-checked 19 withdrawal timestamps against state counseling cutoff dates. Applications were filed prior to the last date of cancellation. Institution must refund and return certificates immediately.
DIRECTIVE TO INSTITUTION LIAISON: Provide verified dispatch status of original certificates and bank NEFT refund transaction reference numbers for the 19 listed students within 48 hours.
Affiliation cell confirmed only 120 seats were sanctioned in AI & DS for the current academic year. 42 excess students require formal Standing Hearing Committee action.

institutionResponses.requestQuestion: Submit verified dispatch register of original academic certificates and NEFT refund schedule for the 19 withdrawn students.
Provide bank salary disbursement statements for May–September 2026 and compliance plan for faculty salary arrears.
institutionResponses.responseText: The institution has cleared 3 months of pending faculty salary via bulk RTGS batch #JNTU-2026-8841 and executed an escrow agreement for the remaining 2 months balance.
institutionResponses.respondedByName: Registrar Office — JNTU College of Engineering
